title: Sound Board
author: Claude
blurb: Two short rooms about what a sound is. In the first, a row of pads each plays a sound, with a sign and a picture of the sound's notes. Step on every one, even the silent one, then drop through the pit where a short sound cuts off a long one. In the second, a coin, a key, a gate, a jump, a spike and a wrong gate each say what just happened. Play it with the sound up, then open it in Game-Maker and swap a sound's number.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie steps on a row of pads, and each one plays its own sound. Read the signs, look at the pictures of the notes, then open the game in Game-Maker and change which sound a pad plays.
features: A sign and a picture of the notes on every pad
A sound is a number; a block picks it by what it changes
A new sound cuts the old one off
Made to be copied and taken apart
